title: Inception
description: A skilled thief who enters people's dreams to steal secrets is given a chance to have his criminal record erased if he can successfully plant an idea into a target's subconscious.

title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman faces the Joker, a criminal mastermind who plunges Gotham City into anarchy, forcing the hero to question everything he stands for.

title: Parasite
description: A poor family schemes to become employed by a wealthy family, with each member posing as an unrelated skilled individual. Tension escalates as their deception grows.

title: Interstellar
description: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival as Earth becomes uninhabitable.

title: Get Out
description: A young Black man visits his white girlfriend's family estate, where he gradually uncovers a disturbing secret.

title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
description: A middle-aged Chinese-American laundromat owner must connect with parallel universe versions of herself to prevent a powerful being from destroying the multiverse.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
description: A banker convicted of murder forms a friendship with a fellow prisoner while maintaining hope for his eventual freedom.

title: Hereditary
description: After the death of their secretive grandmother, a family begins to unravel disturbing secrets about their ancestry, leading to terrifying consequences.

title: Whiplash
description: A young drummer enrolls at a prestigious music conservatory where he falls under the wing of a ruthless and abusive instructor.

title: The Lighthouse
description: Two lighthouse keepers struggle to maintain their sanity while living on a remote and mysterious New England island in the 1890s.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search of her homeland with the aid of a group of female prisoners and a drifter.

title: Knives Out
description: A detective investigates the death of the patriarch of an eccentric, combative family after a mysterious stranger calls into question who really killed him.

title: Arrival
description: A linguist works with the military to communicate with alien lifeforms after twelve mysterious spacecraft appear around the world.

title: Midsommar
description: A couple travels to Sweden to visit a midsummer festival that only takes place every 90 years. What begins as an idyllic retreat quickly devolves into something sinister.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
description: The adventures of a legendary concierge at a famous European hotel between the wars and his friendship with a young employee who becomes his trusted protégé.

title: Oppenheimer
description: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer and his role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II, and the consequences that followed.

title: A Quiet Place
description: A family struggles to survive in a post-apocalyptic world inhabited by blind monsters with an acute sense of hearing.

title: Dune
description: A noble family becomes embroiled in a war for control over the galaxy's most valuable asset, a spice capable of unlocking humanity's greatest potential.

title: The Witch
description: A Puritan family in 1630s New England encounters forces of evil in the woods beyond their farm, leading to paranoia, accusations, and tragic consequences.

title: Annihilation
description: A biologist signs up for a dangerous, secret expedition into a mysterious zone where the laws of nature don't apply.
